seams.name: client module discovery (dsh.client → boot graph)
seams.note: positive: client-bundle row gains a /plugins combo-url entry in the composed Web boot graph (combo rev = composed-rev-index), bundle served from it, row present in composition dump; negative: no-decl control gains no client entry, unknown bundle 404s; loud-failure controls: missing bundle (B3) and malformed dsh.client declaration (B4) abort boot attributable to the package (activation-pass failures aggregate into ClientPackageCompositionError); quirk: a flat top-level "dsh.client" key instead of the nested "dsh": {"client": ...} form is silently ignored (resolveMeta → null, zero diagnostics) — see L6-4

seams.name: remote RPC (authenticated client-request channel)
seams.note: positive: launch URL mints the HMAC auth cookie; authenticated client-request round-trips the registered public channel with the exact wire contract (server-response ok); negative: 401 unauthenticated, 415 wrong content-type, bad-request on method/endpoint mismatch, 200 ok:false error result, 500 handler throw

seams.name: reconnect basic (loss → backoff → reconnect)
seams.note: ConnectionController probe: R1 happy path (+ restart-dedupe contract observation), R2 two-loss state sequence [connected, reconnecting, connected, reconnecting, connected] with backoff intervals within the frozen formula bounds, R3 ready-timeout → first state reconnecting with zero connects, R4 throwing sinks isolated (controller completes all generations), R5 stop-during-backoff leaves exactly one generation and no post-stop events

seams.name: conversation.view seat (Team Tab, list/session)
seams.note: SlotCore driven with declarations mirroring the frozen ui-conversation artifact: Team Tab registers into conversation.view (list/session), shadows at different priority, same-id-same-priority collision throws the verbatim seat message naming the registrant, disposer collapses child declarations with epoch bump and blocks re-register until redeclared

seams.name: sidebar New Team entry (sidebar.footer.action, list/root)
seams.note: SlotCore driven with declarations mirroring the frozen ui-sidebar artifact: New Team action registers into sidebar.footer.action (list/root), squatter collision, missing-id, and dispose→collapse→register-after-collapse all verified

seams.name: conversation input dock (Team Dock fallback seat)
seams.note: frozen DevPlan §15 matrix: the input dock is non-critical and its requirement is satisfied by the frozen fallback clause — an equivalent public seat (conversation.input.dock list/session) exists; Team Dock registers there as fallback-seat evidence, no blocker

seams.name: client bundle missing (negative control)
seams.note: row with dsh.client declaration but no client.js: boot fails fast and loudly; error attributable to MissingClientBundleError naming the package; instance log persisted

seams.name: malformed dsh.client declaration (negative control)
seams.note: row with dsh.client.platform = 42: boot fails fast and loudly; error attributable to the platform validation naming the package; instance log persisted

knownLimitations.title: a flat top-level "dsh.client" key (instead of the nested "dsh": {"client": ...} form) is silently ignored — resolveMeta returns null with no log line and the row is excluded from the client-module graph; the registry reads pkg.dsh.client, and a misdeclared row vanishes with zero diagnostics
knownLimitations.status: documented-characterization: canonical form is {"dsh":{"client":{"platform":"web",...}}} (per packages/client/modules/package.json); probe fixtures use the canonical form; no upstream validation rejects the flat form, so misdeclared rows are undetectable without reading the registry source
